editorial_note: Only claims directly supported by cited sources can pass Atlas review; URLs/catalogue references and unread manuscripts do not establish primary text contents. Source discrepancy: TNA MPF 1/68 is John Goghe 1567 per UK National Archives; Cambridge text's incidental attribution of that shelfmark to Jobson 1589 should not be propagated. TCD MS 1209/36 and DRI DOI supply the verified Jobson 1589 identifier. For Drake 1586 captives, separate alternative Spanish testimonial counts, never sum.
